title: fix(plugin-security): the batched seed existence read's own failure reaches the author with no logger injected
body:
Fixes #18570

Clause-②: no

## What this changes — one site, the delivery only

`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/seed-name-lookup.ts` reported the **batched existence read's own failure** through a doubly-optional `logger?.warn?.(…)`. That call evaluates to NOTHING when the caller injected no sink: the read failed, the oracle silently degraded to the per-item read, and no human was told.

It now reports through **`reportThroughSink`** — the single derivation #18091 landed for exactly this rule, so this sixth instance of the shape (#17516 · #18023 · #18091's five sites) does not become a sixth hand-written copy.

⛔ **Exactly one site.** The triage seat bounded the caliber in as many words and it is not widened here:

> 修法是**那一个站点**,⛔ 不是顺手把全仓 `logger?.warn?.(` 都改 —— 其余站点各自的 caliber 归各自的卡。

No other `logger?.warn?.(` spelling is touched, in this package or anywhere else. `permission-set-projection.ts`, `bootstrap-declared-permissions.ts` and `PermissionSeedOutcome` are untouched — #18571 owns that surface.

**Delivery only.** The wording, the structured meta (`object`, `names`, `rowBudget`, `organization`) and the two named causes — `unreadable` and `truncated` — are axis-specific and stay at the call site, which is the split `seed-refusal-sink.ts` documents. A read that ANSWERED is as silent as it always was, on every channel.

**Why the call site asks `typeof` rather than handing the parameter straight over:** `SeedLookupLogger.warn` is OPTIONAL where `CollisionReportSink.warn` is not, so the host is handed over only once it really carries a callable `warn` — the same question `reportThroughSink` itself asks, moved one frame up so the declared types stay honest instead of being asserted past. ⛔ `seed-refusal-sink.ts` is not edited.

## The evidence bar — a DRIVEN, differential reading, because that is how the card was graded

New suite `seed-name-lookup-degradation-audible.test.ts`, five cases. Case 1 is the card's own shape: an unreadable-database pass with **no logger argument at all**, run beside a **lit control in the same run** — `reportCapabilityRowsUnreadable`, an already-repaired #18091 site that reaches the console with no sink. A zero from the site under repair is a reading only while that control fires.

The other four are what keeps case 1 from being satisfiable by an unconditional `console.warn`:

| case | what it pins |
|---|---|
| 2 | the `truncated` cause travels the same way, `rowBudget` and all |
| 3 | an injected sink still gets the line **with its receiver** (a class-based host), and the console stays out of it |
| 4 | a read that **ANSWERED** is silent on every channel with no sink — the discriminating control #18023 established |
| 5 | a host whose `warn` is not callable reaches the author **without throwing** |

## Reverse verification — the ablation, run from the committed state

The fix was committed first, then `seed-name-lookup.ts` alone was restored to the merge base on disk (proved landed: `reportThroughSink(` count 1 → 0, blob `4d7c35fe` → `83629f98`), the suite re-run, and the file restored to `HEAD` (proved: `git diff HEAD` empty, on-disk blob back to `4d7c35fe`).

Ablated run — **3 of 5 red**, and the failure lines are the measurement:

- case 1 failed at the site-under-repair assertion while the **lit-control assertion above it passed** — i.e. the pre-fix run printed the control line ALONE. That is the card's reading reproduced: ONE author-visible line, this site silent.
- case 2 failed the same way (`expected [] to have a length of 1`).
- case 5 failed with `TypeError: logger?.warn is not a function` thrown out of `buildExistingByName` — so the old spelling did not merely mute a sink-less host, it **aborted the seeding pass** for a host that declared `warn` and shipped something else. `?.()` guards `null`/`undefined`, never a non-callable.
- cases 3 and 4 stayed green pre-fix, exactly as predicted: the mute was never on the injected arm, and a healthy pass was always quiet.

## One file outside the declared surface, named here with its evidence

The dispatch's declared file surface was `seed-name-lookup.ts` + its test. One more file had to move, and it is this card's own harness rather than a second repair:

`bootstrap-declared-capabilities.test.ts` → `[#18091] UNREADABLE ROWS: prints with NO LOGGER INJECTED` asserted `expect(cap.seen).toHaveLength(1)`. **That ONE is the measurement #18570 was filed on.** With both sites now audible the same pass prints two, so the pin reads `toHaveLength(2)` and selects each line by CONTENT (the read fails before the pass summarises, so the #18570 line arrives first). Every content assertion the case already made is preserved, now against its own line. ⛔ No source file of that seeder is touched, and no other assertion in it moves.

Measured before editing it: across **24** open PRs and **325** changed-file rows, `seed-name-lookup.ts` is held by **0** and `bootstrap-declared-capabilities.test.ts` by **0**, with a same-package firing control — PR #18319 does hold `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/suggested-audience-bindings.test.ts` — so both zeros are readings, not a dead scan.

## What was measured

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test` — **exit 0**, `Test Files 115 passed (115) · Tests 2233 passed (2233)`. (One pre-existing case went red on the first run — the control above — and that red is the finding, repaired as described.)

The third reports `0 file(s) / 0 error(s) / 0 pinned signature(s)`; this package carries no `test-typecheck-debt.json`.

Reconciled with `--ran`: `60 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 60 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 60 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3), 0 UNRUN`.
- Three of the 60 answered **exit 3 = PREREQUISITE NOT MET = NOT MEASURED** on first run — `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:type-check-debt` — each naming a built-output prerequisite. The closure was built and all three re-run to **exit 0**. ⛔ None was reported as a pass on its 3.

- Exported surface unchanged: `src/index.ts` re-exports nothing from `seed-name-lookup.ts`, and the built `dist/index.d.ts` carries `SeedLookupLogger` **0** times against a positive control of `SecurityPlugin` **22** times. ⇒ `Clause-②: no` still holds.

Two verdict lines worth carrying out of logs that die with the worktree:

- `check:engine-double-contract` — `UNRECOGNISED [engine-double-contract]: 9 construct(s) in packages, examples declare a scanned verb (delete, update, findOne) alongside engine siblings, and this gate could not read the implementation -- so they are in NEITHER the pinned population nor the ledger. 213 further construct(s) are SCOPED OUT by a stated criterion and are not counted here. This is a verdict, not a finding: it never fails a run (#9747, ruling of 2026-08-18).` None of the nine is a file in this diff.
- `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`, verbatim:

```text

```

## Changeset

`patch` on `@objectstack/plugin-security`. Decided by reading, not habit: the package declares no `private` and ships `files: ["dist", "README.md", "CHANGELOG.md"]`, and `seed-name-lookup.ts` compiles into that `dist` — so this publishes.

## Acceptance notes

- **noted, not filed** — `logger?.warn?.(…)` does not protect a host whose `warn` is present but not callable; it throws. That is a property of the spelling, so every remaining site in the class carries it, and each of those sites belongs to its own card (triage's bound above). Recorded here rather than filed because the class already has an owner: `reportThroughSink` is the repair, and the remaining sites are already enumerated on the sibling cards. 承接者: the seat that dispatches the next site in this class.
- **noted, not filed** — `SeedLookupLogger` still declares `info?`, which nothing in `seed-name-lookup.ts` reads. Dead declaration, not a defect, and out of scope for a Clause-② `no` card. 承接者: 无.
